description:
Lists the series the Stack serves, across every dataset: the credit tree at every level (market, class, family, venue) and figure, for bitcoin and, separately, for ether collateral; the liquidation map's bands; the credit x on-chain measures and their sub-series; the governed indices; wrapper reserve coverage; the chain, miner, on-chain price and FX series from Aletheia's own node; the Treasury curve (H.15); SOFR and the stablecoin total. Each row: id, label, unit, group, collateral, cadence, kinds, first and last date, licence, the site page that shows it, whether it can be charted (and why not), and whether the site's explorer draws it.

Paged: 100 rows by default (limit up to 500); pass the returned `next` as cursor. Narrow with dataset, group, collateral, prefix (e.g. 'credit.class.algorithmic.') or q (a word in the id or label). Then fetch values with get_series.

Standard questions this tool answers (get_guide with question): SQ-Ch1, SQ-S4.

chartable_only.description: Leave out series that cannot be drawn on a time chart

collateral.description: Series measured against bitcoin or against ether collateral; never added together

cursor.description: The `next` value of the previous page

dataset.description: A dataset from the answer's `datasets`, e.g. credit_tree, credit_tree_eth, cx, chain_series, macro

group.description: One of the explorer's picker groups

q.description: A word to find in the id or label

name: list_series
title: Every chartable series (catalogue)
